s.en: Directory/file, DNS and virtual host brute-forcing tool written in Go

syn: Modes: dir - Enumerate directories and files on web servers ⏎ dns - Discover subdomains through DNS resolution ⏎ s3 - Enumerate Amazon S3 buckets ⏎ gcs - Enumerate Google Cloud Storage buckets ⏎ vhost - Discover virtual hosts on web servers ⏎ fuzz - Custom fuzzing with the FUZZ keyword

o.en: Time each thread waits between requests (e.g. 1500ms)
Output file to write results to (defaults to stdout)
Don't print the banner and other noise
